blocks.text: P-pop powerhouse BGYO brings back the smooth and romantic sounds of classic 2000s R&B in its latest single, “Candlelit”. The playful new track explores themes of devotion, intimacy, and fulfilling a partner’s needs at their own pace. Furthermore, the release arrives as a three-track single pack that includes the original version, an English version, and an instrumental track. This format gives listeners multiple ways to experience the song.
